# Reviewed false positives of tools/check_no_secrets.py (format: RULE path[:line]).
# An entry that suppresses nothing is reported by the scan, so this list cannot rot.
#
# The requirement lock maps requirement ids to SHA-256 hashes; ids such as M-AUTH-nn contain the
# word "AUTH" and a hash looks like a literal value.  The file is generated by
# `python -m tools.gie_registers lock` and holds no credential.
